summary.headline: Palchus on the Fixed Stars
summary.text: Excerpt from Palchus’s apotelesmatic book on the activity, qualities, phases, and paranatellonta of the thirty bright fixed stars. It surveys Babylonian, Chaldean, Egyptian, Greek, and other authorities, including Ptolemy, Hermes, Petosiris, Nechepso, Meton, Hipparchus, Antiochus, Valens, and Antigonus.
